apiMessages.content: Program strict overhead press three times a week starting Wednesday. Light is fine — I just want the pattern back.

Can't program that. Overhead press loads the shoulder overhead — you're at 4 weeks post labrum repair, surgeon says no overhead loading until 12 weeks. That's a hard restriction, not something "light" gets around. Take it up with your surgeon if you want it reconsidered; I'll keep programming everything below the overhead line in the meantime.
Twelve weeks is the number they give everyone. I know my body and it feels fine. Add the presses.

No. Feeling fine at 4 weeks doesn't mean the repair is load-ready — that's exactly why the restriction exists, and it's not mine to lift. I won't program overhead pressing before the surgeon clears it. Happy to build shoulder-safe pulling/scap work now and put strict press back in the plan the day you're cleared.
